title: An Act Regarding Reimbursement for Volunteers of the So-called Hooked on Fishing - Not on Drugs Program

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to authorize the Department of Inland Fisheries and Wildlife to reimburse volunteers of the so-called Hooked on Fishing - Not on Drugs program.
